title: office.session-brief request
description: Assemble the deterministic brief for the current workspace. Call before opening a new conversation source. Optionally pass the current session's project and orchestrator to lead with that thread's handoff, followed by the open global handoffs, and list other recent threads in other_sessions; with no project the legacy single-conversation output is returned, plus the open global handoffs. The SessionStart hook sets session_start, so the Library setting brief.handoff (auto | manual) applies; view handoffs is the /handoff command. No inference or writes.

project.description: Current project (repository name or working-directory path, normalized to the repository name). Absent or null keeps the legacy output.

orchestrator.description: Current orchestrator as conversation sources record it: the provider name (claude, codex), not the crew name; inside the project, its thread's handoff leads. Absent or null means no orchestrator preference.

task.description: The caller's open assignment task id. Only with session_start and no project, in brief.handoff auto: when Orbit reports it open, the project is the one its handoff thread was recorded in; otherwise the brief is the manual output.

session_start.description: True when the SessionStart hook asks. Applies brief.handoff: manual leaves out the project handoff and other_sessions and lists projects; auto uses project, else the task fallback, else the manual output. Absent or false: the request's project is always used.

view.description: brief (default) is the full brief. handoffs is the /handoff command: with a project, its handoff then global; without one, global then projects. Reads no Orbit tasks; cannot be combined with session_start.
